title: The Quiet Debt
author: Lena Blackwood
blurb: Ines Delacroix, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must trade the one secret worth killing for before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
